questions: When the board is fully visible, does it hold exactly three pens arranged in a single row?
Are all three pens aligned identically, all pointing the same way, including any pen near the left or right frame edge as it enters or exits?
Do all three pens share identical barrel and cap colors, with no mismatch?
Is every pen fully capped with no exposed writing tip, and are all three pens equal in length?
Does the board advance steadily from left to right at EVERY moment, never halting, freezing, or pausing even briefly (1-3 seconds) at any point in the video?
Do all pens stay fixed in their positions on the board, with no pen shifting, sliding, or moving on its own relative to the board mid-clip?

question_answers.evidence: From frame 7 onwards, the board is sufficiently visible and holds exactly three pens in a row.
All three pens are oriented with their caps facing downwards (towards the bottom of the frame) and barrels upwards.
The leftmost pen is blue with a clear cap, while the other two pens are black/dark grey with black caps. They do not share identical colors.
All pens appear to have caps on the bottom end. No bare writing tips are exposed.
The board progresses smoothly from the left edge of the frame to the right edge across the sequence of frames without stopping.
The relative positions of the pens on the board remain constant throughout the clip.

parsed.reason: The three pens are not identical in color; one is blue while the other two are black, violating the condition that all pens must share the same color.

description: One pen differs in color from the other two.
